code.text: COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows marked hypoxemia, mild normocytic anemia, leukopenia with neutropenia, mild thrombocytopenia, and elevated inflammatory markers (CRP, ferritin, LDH). There is also metabolic acidosis (low CO₂), abnormal white cell differential (monocytosis, basophilia), and a significantly elevated INR. Findings suggest acute or chronic inflammatory/infectious process with possible coagulopathy and impaired oxygenation; clinical correlation and urgent evaluation are recommended.
